testcase.name: Scenario: Share the panel-title setting between two ribbon tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:115:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Share the panel-title setting between two ribbon tabs ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon shows panel titles ✔ When the user clears Show Panel Titles from the 3D Model tab context menu ✔ And the user selects the Tools tab ✔ Then the Tools panel titles are hidden ✔ When the user opens the Tools tab context menu ✔ Then Show Panel Titles is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Show Panel Titles from that menu ✔ Then the Tools panel titles appear ✔ When the user returns to 3D Model ✔ Then the 3D Model panel titles are visible
